name: TAF Inpatient Claims Occurrence Codes File
description: The TAF Inpatient Claims Occurrence Codes file contains occurrence code records associated with inpatient hospital claims submitted to Medicaid. Each record represents one occurrence code entry on a claim and includes the occurrence code and associated date, capturing events relevant to the hospitalization such as accident dates, onset of symptoms, or Medicare benefit exhaustion. Note: not all states are available in TAF data from 2014-2015, as this was a transition period between MAX and TAF. From 2016-2018, all states are available.

license.name: No license, user must be under Data User Agreement (DUA)

name: TAF Inpatient Claims Occurrence Codes
description: Occurrence code records from the CMS T-MSIS Analytic Files (TAF) Inpatient Claims. Each row represents a single occurrence code entry associated with an inpatient facility claim. Occurrence codes are UB-04 standardized codes that indicate specific events during or related to the hospitalization.

content.bene_id: String: BENE_ID. Encrypted CCW beneficiary identifier assigned to uniquely identify an individual across CCW files.
content.msis_id: String: MSIS_ID. Encrypted state-assigned beneficiary unique identifier used to identify a Medicaid or CHIP beneficiary and associated claims.
content.state_cd: String: STATE_CD. Two-letter postal abbreviation for the state that submitted the TAF claim.
content.submitting_state: String: SUBMTG_STATE_CD. Numeric state/entity code for the U.S. state, territory, District of Columbia, or related reporting entity that submitted the data.
content.clm_id: String: CLM_ID. Unique CCW claim identifier used to link header, line, and occurrence records for the same claim.
content.ocrnc_cd_seq: String: OCRNC_CD_SEQ. Sequence number of the occurrence code related to the claim.
content.ocrnc_cd: String: OCRNC_CD. Occurrence code describing specific event(s) relating to the billing period covered by the claim.
content.ocrnc_cd_start_dt: Date32[day]: OCRNC_CD_START_DT. Start date of the corresponding occurrence code or occurrence span code.
content.ocrnc_cd_end_dt: Date32[day]: OCRNC_CD_END_DT. Last end date on which the corresponding occurrence code or occurrence span code was applicable.
content.filename: String: FILENAME. Likely a local provenance field storing the source file name.
content.year: Int64: YEAR. Likely a local partition or reporting year field maintained outside the IP occurrence codebook schema.
